content: # Hofpfisterei. | Native name | Ludwig Stocker Hofpfisterei GmbH |. | Headquarters | Kreittmayrstraße 5, 80335 Munich , Germany |. | Key people | Margaretha Stocker (strategic management), Nicole Stocker (managing director) |. | Number of employees | 910 (2010) Edit this on Wikidata |. **Hofpfisterei** is a chain of bakery shops, headquartered in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. Its business focusses on southern Germany. It has 163 branches and employs about 950 people. Its history reaches back to the year 1331 when the mill *Toratsmühle* was mentioned for the first time. The bakery also sells its products online. From 1978 the bread contains no additives and the flours are examined for residues in their own laboratory. However, examinations by foodwatch in 2008 showed that some additives had been used and Hofpfisterei has since made some changes. content: # Hofpfisterei GmbH. The Ludwig Stocker Hofpfisterei GmbH is a traditional company with over 700 years of history that produces high-quality, organic baked goods. With a strong focus on sustainability and regional ingredients, the Hofpfisterei offers healthy products for environmentally conscious consumers. ## Company Description: Ludwig Stocker Hofpfisterei GmbH. The Ludwig Stocker Hofpfisterei GmbH, short Hofpfisterei, looks back on a rich history that dates back to 1331. Over the centuries, Hofpfisterei developed into an independent company, which has been in the hands of the Stocker family since the 17th century[3]. The ingredients come from organic farming, with the exception of sea salt and water[2][3]. The mission of Hofpfisterei is to produce high-quality baked goods under strict ecological criteria and thus contribute to the well-being of consumers and the preservation of the environment. The company places great importance on sustainability and close cooperation with organic farmers. Hofpfisterei is a pioneer in organic farming and baking.
